prompt: Write a Python function called `lazy_segment_tree` that takes an integer `n` (initial array length, all zeros), and a list `operations`. Implement the Li Chao segment tree (convex hull trick) where each node of a segment tree over the x-range stores the dominant line at its segment midpoint.
